data.name: Diana
data.message: Electrical done, heading to weapons via security. Want to come?

I found Bob's body in security when I arrived there. My route was medbay -> electrical -> security. 

Here's what I saw: At tick 4, I was in medbay with Eve — she came in from electrical. Then I moved to electrical, where I saw Frank at ticks 6, 7, and 8 — he had come in from security at tick 6. I continued to security and found Bob dead there.

Important: Frank is also dead, and the meeting says his body is in medbay. So someone killed Frank in medbay after I left. Eve was in medbay when I left it heading to electrical — she's the prime suspect for Frank's death. And whoever killed Bob in security did it before I arrived, or Bob was killed by someone coming from cafeteria/navigation side.

Frank came FROM security at tick 6 — so Frank could have killed Bob in security, then moved to electrical. But then Frank himself died in medbay later, meaning someone else killed Frank.

I'm leaning toward Eve being suspicious since she was last seen with Frank's body location (medbay). Let's hear from Alice, Charlie, and Eve.

I don't have much to contribute on the kills themselves — my route was just storage to lower engine, and I didn't see anyone the entire time. I was completely alone, so unfortunately I have no alibi and no witnesses to share.

What I can say is that Diana's timeline sounds detailed and consistent. If Eve was in medbay when Diana left, and Frank ended up dead in medbay, that's a strong lead. But I'd like to hear Eve explain her movements before we commit — she might have left medbay before Frank arrived. Charlie has been quiet too, and we haven't heard where he was during all this.

Eve, Charlie — we need clear routes from both of you. Right now Eve looks most suspicious based on Diana's account, but let's not lock in until we hear them out.

I started navigation, went up through security, then weapons, cafeteria, and toward medbay at the end. Early in security I saw Frank there for a bit, and I saw Bob alive in security when I was leaving — I didn’t see any body there at that time. After that I was in weapons/cafeteria and didn’t see anyone.

I did get to medbay right at the end and saw Frank’s body basically as the report got called, so I didn’t have time to report it myself. I didn’t see Eve there when I arrived, but Diana’s info still matters: Eve was in medbay earlier, and Frank ends up dead there later. 

For Bob, I think the key is security timing — if Frank left security and Bob died there after, then either someone came through after me, or Frank killed Bob and then later got killed in medbay. But for Frank’s death, Eve still looks like the best lead unless she has a really clear route out of medbay.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> upper engine. I started in electrical, moved to medbay, and then went to upper engine to do my Align Engine Output task. I didn't actually see any other players during my route — Diana says she saw me in medbay coming from electrical at tick 4, which matches my movement, but I didn't see her there (we may have just crossed paths quickly).

Here's the key point though: I left medbay heading to upper engine. Frank's body was found in medbay. For me to have killed Frank, Frank would have had to enter medbay while I was still there — but Diana says Frank was in electrical at ticks 6, 7, and 8. I was already gone from medbay to upper engine by then. Someone else had to enter medbay after Frank left electrical and kill him there.

Who could that be? Diana herself went medbay -> electrical -> security, so she was in electrical with Frank at ticks 6-8. After Frank left electrical, Diana continued to security — but Diana could have doubled back, OR someone from cafeteria/storage could have entered medbay.

Charlie says he ended in medbay and saw Frank's body "right as the report was called" — that's convenient timing. Charlie also places himself in security early and saw Bob alive there, then went weapons/cafeteria/medbay. That puts Charlie near both crime scenes with no witnesses for most of it.

Alice was alone in storage/lower engine — also no alibi, but storage connects to medbay too.

I think Diana's read on me is wrong because of the timing. My strongest suspicion is Charlie — he was in security when Bob was there, and arrived in medbay right when Frank's body appeared. I vote Charlie.

I already gave my full account, so let me respond to what's been said.

Eve makes a fair point about timing — if Frank was in electrical with me at ticks 6, 7, 8, then Eve being in medbay at tick 4 doesn't automatically make her Frank's killer. She would've had to wait around in medbay for Frank to come back, which doesn't match her claim of going to upper engine.

But here's what bothers me about Charlie: he says he saw Bob ALIVE in security as he was leaving, then went weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay and arrived at Frank's body "right as the report was called." That's two crime scenes with no witnesses. And critically — I was in security and found Bob's body. If Charlie left security with Bob alive, then either Frank killed Bob (Frank came FROM security at tick 6), or someone else entered security after Charlie left.

The Frank-killed-Bob theory actually works: Frank kills Bob in security, moves to electrical (where I see him), then goes to medbay where the real killer finishes him off. The question is who was in medbay at that time.

Charlie's route ends in medbay at the exact moment Frank's body is there. Eve claims she left medbay for upper engine before Frank arrived. I'm now leaning toward Charlie being the Duck. I want to hear if anyone can verify Charlie was actually in weapons or cafeteria.

I already gave my route — storage to lower engine, no witnesses, nothing to add there. So let me focus on what's been said.

Eve's timing defense is actually solid: if Frank was in electrical at ticks 6-8 with Diana, then Eve being in medbay at tick 4 doesn't put her at Frank's murder. She'd have had to linger in medbay waiting, which contradicts her stated path to upper engine. That's a real alibi gap working in her favor.

Charlie's story is what concerns me now. He places himself in security with Bob alive, then conveniently loops through weapons and cafeteria — rooms where he saw no one — and arrives in medbay exactly when Frank's body is discovered. Two crime scenes, zero witnesses, and perfect timing on the second one. That's a lot to swallow.

The Frank-killed-Bob-then-got-killed theory also fits: Frank in security with Bob, Frank leaves to electrical, then Frank heads to medbay where someone finishes him. Charlie ending up in medbay right then is the cleanest fit for that "someone."

I'm leaning Charlie. Diana, you went security after Charlie supposedly left — can you confirm whether Bob's body looked fresh or if there were any signs of who was just there? Either way, my vote is heading toward Charlie unless he gives us something concrete.

I get why my route looks ugly on paper, but I think people are making the “arrived at body = killed it” jump too fast.

I was honest about ending in medbay because I literally walked in and saw Frank’s body as Diana’s report hit. If I were trying to hide something, I could’ve just said I was still cafeteria/weapons and nobody would have been able to contradict that. I didn’t get a chance to report because the meeting was pulled immediately.

For Bob: I saw Frank in security first, then Bob alive in security after that, and then I left toward weapons. Diana’s own timeline has Frank coming from security into electrical right after. So Bob dying in security does not point cleanly to me — I wasn’t there when Diana arrived, and Frank’s movement through that area is confirmed by Diana.

For Frank: the only person actually placed in medbay earlier by someone else is Eve. Her whole defense is “I left to upper engine,” but nobody saw that. Upper engine is right next to medbay, so she could have left, doubled back, or just stayed around long enough for Frank to come in. Alice has no alibi either, but Eve is the one confirmed at the room where Frank died.

I think Eve shifted hard onto me because my route is easy to make sound bad, but her timing is not as clear as she’s making it. My vote is still going Eve here.

This is my second speech, so let me be direct since I'm the final voice before votes.

Charlie's defense rests on "Eve was placed in medbay so she's the killer" — but he's ignoring the timing. Diana confirmed Frank was in electrical at ticks 6, 7, AND 8. That's three ticks. I was in medbay at tick 4 and moved to upper engine. For me to kill Frank, I'd have to sit in medbay doing nothing for 4+ ticks waiting for him — and Diana would have seen me still there when she passed through, but she said I came in from electrical and she continued on. She didn't say I was loitering.

Meanwhile, Charlie's route has him at BOTH crime scenes. He admits he was in security with Bob, and he admits he arrived in medbay exactly when Frank's body was there. His "I could have lied about my route" argument is weak — claiming cafeteria with no witnesses would have looked just as suspicious as what he said.

Also, Charlie's path weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay passes right through the cafeteria, which connects to medbay directly. He had clean access to medbay at the right time to kill Frank.

Alice's storage/lower engine route keeps her far from both bodies. Diana's account has been consistent and detailed throughout.

My vote is Charlie.
